cards.answer: Naafiri is an AD-focused assassin and fighter who directs packmates onto her targets. She uses bleeding daggers and champion-targeted dashes to deliver physical damage.
cards.counterplay: Avoid her daggers and keep allied support nearby when she threatens to engage.

cards.counterplay: Clear packmates when safe and avoid unnecessary ability hits that help replenish her pack.

cards.answer: Darkin Daggers throws a physical-damage dagger that applies a bleed and can be recast. Hitting an already bleeding target deals the remaining bleed damage plus bonus damage; hitting a bleeding champion or large monster also heals Naafiri. Packmates leap onto the first champion or monster hit.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the follow-up dagger, especially while bleeding or low on health.

cards.answer: The Call of the Pack briefly makes Naafiri untargetable and temporarily vanishes her packmates. During the hunt, she gains attack damage, speeds up herself and her packmates, and summons extra packmates. Casting Hounds' Pursuit extends the hunt.
cards.counterplay: Hold targeted abilities while she is untargetable and create distance during the hunt.

cards.answer: Eviscerate dashes through enemies for physical damage, then damages nearby enemies on arrival. It recalls her packmates to her and fully heals them.
cards.counterplay: Keep clear of her dash path and landing area; expect her pack to return healthy.

cards.answer: Hounds' Pursuit briefly channels before Naafiri and her packmates dash at a target champion, dealing physical damage and briefly slowing the target. A champion takedown shortly after casting reveals nearby enemy champions and unlocks a recast. The recast grants Naafiri a shield before repeating the pursuit.
cards.counterplay: Use interrupting crowd control during the channel and protect vulnerable allies from takedowns that enable another pursuit.
